name: Selfish
effect: eats an extra ration at night
onset: {name} is Selfish now: they help themselves at night until morale is back to 3.
recover: {name} put the can opener back on the shelf. They're themselves again.
warning_1: {name}, counting cans: "Some of us are doing more than others."
warning_2: {name} has started keeping a list of who ate what.
warning_3: {name}, at the shelf: "Funny how the good cans always go first."

name: Paranoid
effect: won't open the hatch for anyone, or go out
onset: {name} is Paranoid now: the hatch stays shut until morale is back to 3.
recover: {name} let someone else check the hatch. They're steadier now.
warning_1: {name} has checked the hatch four times since lunch.
warning_2: {name}, very quietly: "Anyone could be listening to us."
warning_3: {name} wants to know who touched the hatch last.

name: Reckless
effect: goes to the farthest place on the map
onset: {name} is Reckless now: they'll head for the farthest place on the map until morale is back to 3.
recover: {name} planned a short trip on the map. They're themselves again.
warning_1: {name}, at the map: "Sitting here is how we die."
warning_2: {name} keeps lacing and unlacing their boots.
warning_3: {name} has started measuring the distance to everywhere.

name: Withdrawn
onset: {name} is Withdrawn now: they won't work until morale is back to 3.
recover: {name} asked what day it is. That's a good sign.
warning_2: {name} has been facing the wall since breakfast.
warning_3: {name} hasn't eaten much or said much today.
